name: The SmartFuel callout steps speak the percentages their labels say
step: Check the SmartFuel callout steps and the Fuel page default
rationale: Issue #2757: the Fuel page's Every 5% choice spoke only at 50 and 5 percent, because its table in tasks/audio_events.lua was {50, 5}, and Default was described as leaving the choice to the flight controller although it speaks at 10 percent only (the 100 step can never be crossed). The Every 5% table now has every 5 percent step from 95 down to 5, the Fuel page's default is the Default choice (0) that a new settings store holds, and the Fuel and Battery docs say that 0 percent is the consumption reserve set by Consumption Warning percent. The harness drives the real tasks/audio_events.lua with a falling fuel value, one percent per wakeup, and checks the percentages spoken for each callout step. Its self-test restores the old table and requires Every 5% to go red.
